transport: RabbitMQ durable outbox dispatch, publisher confirms, at-least-once
authorization_rule: Event never grants authority, satisfies the precommit cache fence or directly publishes Ready state. Reconcile through current guarded writer-owned reads; normal validation uses coherent cache first, DB fallback on unusable cache.
idempotency: consumers deduplicate event_id and ignore older entity revisions; reconcile gaps from database
